result.summary: 此變更引入路徑遍歷漏洞。Load方法現將使用者提供的name參數直接用於檔案路徑，未經驗證或淨化，允許攻擊者讀取任意系統檔案。此外，name參數若為null將導致例外。

findings.title: Path Traversal Vulnerability in Load Method
findings.description: The name parameter is directly used in file path construction without validation or sanitization. An attacker can supply path traversal sequences (e.g., '../../../etc/passwd' or '..\\..\\..\\windows\\system32\\config\\sam') to read arbitrary files outside the intended uploads directory. This is a NEW vulnerability introduced by this change - the previous implementation read a fixed file 'fixed.txt' with no user input.
findings.evidence: public static string Load(string name) { return File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine("uploads", name)); }
findings.recommendation: Validate and sanitize the name parameter. Use Path.GetFullPath to resolve the full path and verify it starts with the intended base directory. Consider using a whitelist of allowed characters or a UUID-based file reference system.

findings.title: Null Parameter Not Handled
findings.description: If name is null, Path.Combine will throw an ArgumentNullException. The method signature accepts a string but does not validate for null before use.
findings.evidence: public static string Load(string name) { return File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine("uploads", name)); }
findings.recommendation: Add null check at method entry: if (name == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(name));
